action: Iris Ohyama account holders: change your password and change it anywhere else you used the same one, since the strength of the protection is not stated. Watch for emails or messages pretending to be from the company.
date_note: Reported in a Nov 6-12 roundup; exact disclosure day not confirmed
exec: A supplier breach affecting about 7.7 million customers, with password protection strength not disclosed.
plain: Japanese household goods maker Iris Ohyama said a break-in at an outside cloud service exposed personal data for about 7.7 million people, including account passwords that it says were scrambled.
summary: A breach at a third-party cloud service exposed personal data including account passwords. The company says the passwords were encrypted but has not named the algorithm.
title: Iris Ohyama: cloud service breach affects about 7.7 million people

validation.note: One roundup; exact disclosure day unknown.
